title: Produce independent send-composition actuation-proof candidates
summary: Implement REQ-QUIC-CRT-0218 through REQ-QUIC-CRT-0222 as a release-identity correction, additive candidate proof contract, reusable offline evidence bridge, independent batch and buffer correctness proof bundles, negative fixtures, and review package.
planned_changes: Include decision identity in initial release-to-operation lookup; add deterministic duplicate-ID release fixtures; define a strict candidate proof schema; capture existing batch and buffer mechanism evidence through a focused one-axis harness; assemble all fifteen immutable projection inputs for each proof; recompute both materializations and projections; emit candidate-only proof records and an unapplied promotion patch; add closed negative cases; and synchronize direct trace and review documentation.
verification_plan: Run the foundation, compiler/manifest, runtime-evidence, hardening, closeout, and independent-proof regressions; prove exact release resolution; execute only the two independent one-axis correctness harnesses; validate schemas, hashes, references, materialization recomputation, and projection determinism; build Incursa.Quic and Incursa.Quic.Tests in Release; run focused mechanism, ownership, requirement-home, and direct SpecTrace validation; and run git diff --check.
out_of_scope: Multi-axis interaction execution or runtime capability expansion
Performance measurement, ProtocolLab campaigns, large matrices, transforms, threshold derivation, or ML
CI changes, push, active_internal, or production activation
